notes.title: Escape the Kreegan 1.0 and Original Sound Track
notes.notes:
This marks the end of the main development of Escape the Kreegan, with the release of 1.0 and its Original Sound Track.

Update Notes:
[list]
[*] Added Steam Achievements
[*] Added Steam Leaderboard Highscores
[*] Removed Local Highscores
[*] Added Menu localization support [English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese and Russian]
[/list]
